[EN] Like we didn't have enough troubles! The kulkari have driven the {@LinkCreature:6#2041#ravenous bears} out of their homes and soon enough, they'll be looking here for food.

Drive them off or take them out. Whatever it takes, just get them away from here.
[ES] ¡Como si no tuviéramos suficientes problemas! Los kulkari han expulsado a los {@LinkCreature:6#2041#ravenous bears} de sus hogares y muy pronto vendrán aquí en busca de comida.

Ahuyéntalos o elimínalos. Hagas lo que hagas, solo apártalos de este lugar.

[EN] Thanks. Imagine—driving the kulkari off only to be devoured by bears!
[ES] Gracias. ¡Imagínate: ahuyentar a los kulkari para terminar devorado por los osos!
